title: Office Admin
description:
Vision India Insurance is looking for a responsible, organized, and proactive Office Administrator to join our team in Coimbatore.

The selected candidate will be responsible for managing internal systems and records, maintaining agent and customer data, coordinating daily operational activities, monitoring recruitment and onboarding processes, and supporting the team with administrative and system-related tasks.

This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable working with Microsoft Excel, WhatsApp, Google Forms, databases, and office tools, has strong coordination and follow-up skills, and can efficiently manage multiple tasks while maintaining accurate records.

Important: This is a full-time, office-based position. Work From Home is not available.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Communicate with existing customers and provide professional assistance.
* Understand customer requirements and collect relevant information.
* Handle customer queries and service-related concerns.
* Provide appropriate information and assistance based on customer requirements.
* Maintain accurate records of customer calls, interactions, and transactions.
* Conduct timely follow-ups with customers.
* Maintain professional and positive customer relationships.

**System Administration & Operations**

* Manage and update WhatsApp Status and other team communication requirements.
* Receive, organize, and distribute leads to Telecalling Executives.
* Monitor pending applications and ensure timely follow-ups.
* Send Google Forms to new agents and track completion of required details and documents.
* Verify new agent applications and submitted documents.
* Coordinate branch verification for new agent applications.
* Monitor the agent onboarding process, including interviews, examinations, and first policy login.
* Upload and maintain daily data related to Telecaller appointments, Facebook leads, and field leads.
* Create and organize folders for LIC and Star Health licenses and insurance-related documents.
* Contact inactive agents to collect updated information.
* Maintain and update the agent master sheet.
* Track agent performance and success metrics using Excel.
* Maintain accurate internal databases and operational records.
* Manage and organize appointment letters and other important documents.
* Prepare and submit daily activity and operational reports.
* Identify opportunities to improve internal workflows and office processes.
* Coordinate with different teams to ensure smooth day-to-day operations.
* Ensure important data and records are updated regularly and maintained systematically.

**Eligibility & Skills**

* Education: Any Degree / Relevant Qualification.
* Experience in System Administration, Office Administration, Operations, Data Management, or Coordination will be an added advantage.
* Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, WhatsApp, Google Forms, and other office tools.
* Basic understanding of data management and record maintenance.
* Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to handle customer and agent information accurately.
* Strong follow-up and coordination skills.
* Good problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple responsibilities within deadlines.
* Experience with CRM software, databases, or agent onboarding systems will be an added advantage.
* Positive attitude and willingness to learn new systems and processes.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality of customer, agent, and company information.

**Key Skills**

Microsoft Excel | Data Management | System Administration | Google Forms | WhatsApp | Database Management | Documentation | Operations Coordination | Customer Support | Agent Onboarding | Follow-up | Reporting | Computer Skills

**Salary & Benefits**

* Attractive salary based on experience and skills.
* Performance-based incentives.
* Training and professional guidance.
* Career growth opportunities.
* Cell phone reimbursement.
* Commuter assistance.
* Supportive and professional work environment.

Working Hours

**Monday to Saturday**  
**9:00 AM – 6:30 PM**

**Work Location:** In person, Coimbatore

**Work Mode:** Full-time, Office-based

Pay: ₹12,000.00 - ₹15,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: QA Manual- Pharmacy Claims
description:
**Work Location - Initially Remote, Later hybrid for Coimbatore**

We are looking for a QA Engineer with strong experience in US Healthcare applications, preferably with exposure to Pharmacy, PBM, Prescription Claims, Drug Management, or Healthcare Claims processing.

Prior 340B experience is preferred but not mandatory.

The candidate should have strong healthcare domain fundamentals and should be capable of quickly understanding and testing 340B workflows.

Experience

- 4+ years of QA / Software Testing experience

- 2+ years of experience working on US Healthcare applications

- Experience in Pharmacy, PBM, Healthcare Claims, Prescription Claims, Medicaid/Medicare, or similar healthcare products preferred

Key Domain Skills

Candidates with experience in any of the following areas are preferred:

- Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM)

- Pharmacy / Prescription Claims

- Healthcare Claims Processing

- Claim Adjudication

- Medicaid / Medicare

- Drug / NDC Management

- Patient Eligibility

- Provider / Pharmacy Management

- Claim Reversal / Reprocessing

- Financial Reconciliation

- Healthcare Billing

- Contract Pharmacy workflows

- Drug purchase, dispense, and replenishment workflows

Testing Skills

- Strong Functional and Regression Testing experience

- End-to-end healthcare workflow validation

- API Testing using Postman or similar tools

- Strong SQL and database validation

- Backend data validation

- Batch / file processing validation

- Data reconciliation testing

- Integration testing across multiple systems

- Ability to validate large-volume healthcare transaction data

- Good understanding of defect analysis and root-cause investigation

Technical Knowledge

Good understanding of:

- REST APIs

- JSON

- SQL

- Database queries

- Healthcare integrations

- EDI / batch files

- Data mapping and transformation

- Authentication and authorization

- HIPAA / PHI handling

Exposure to healthcare standards such as HL7, FHIR, X12, or NCPDP is an added advantage.

340B Knowledge – Preferred, Not Mandatory

Experience or understanding of any of the following will be an added advantage:

- 340B Drug Pricing Program

- Covered Entities

- Contract Pharmacies

- Third-Party Administrators (TPA)

- 340B Eligibility

- Claim qualification

- Accumulator processing

- Split Billing

- Drug replenishment

- Medicaid Carve-In / Carve-Out

- Duplicate Discount prevention

- Diversion prevention

- HRSA / OPAIS

- 340B audit and compliance workflows

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Provident Fund
* Work from home

Application Question(s):

* What is your CTC & ECTC ?
* What is your notice period ?
* This job is initially remote, later hybrid for Coimbatore. Are you comfortable relocating to Coimbatore ?

Experience:

* QA Manual: 4 years (Required)
* Healthcare Pharmacy Claims: 2 years (Required)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu

title: LEAD ADMINISTRATOR L1(CONTRACT)
description:
Job Title: LEAD ADMINISTRATOR L1(CONTRACT)

City: Pune

State/Province: Maharashtra

Posting Start Date: 10/13/26

Wipro Limited (NYSE: WIT, BSE: 507685, NSE: WIPRO) is a leading technology services and consulting company focused on building innovative solutions that address clients’ most complex digital transformation needs. Leveraging our holistic portfolio of capabilities in consulting, design, engineering, and operations, we help clients realize their boldest ambitions and build future-ready, sustainable businesses. With over 230,000 employees and business partners across 65 countries, we deliver on the promise of helping our customers, colleagues, and communities thrive in an ever-changing world. For additional information, visit us at www.wipro.com.

Role Purpose

The purpose of this role is to resolve high-priority incidents through advanced troubleshooting, ensure SLA compliance, analyse system performance trends, and create mitigation measures by collaborating with internal and external stakeholders.

**͏**
-----

Areas of responsibility

Triaging and resolution of tickets-Provide resolution to high priority incident (P2) tickets, performing advanced troubleshooting and root cause analysis to ensure timely closure.

SLA Monitoring-Ensure SLA compliance for assigned technology areas and ensure proactive escalation management.

Performance tuning and optimization-Analyse system performance data, coordinate findings on system behaviour, and support capacity planning initiatives to enhance overall system efficiency.

Perform system Improvements-Create mitigation measures to evaluate new tools or improvements by collaborating with technical teams.

Handling disaster recovery-Perform security assessments and recovery drills, and implement necessary controls to ensure compliance with established security standards.

Reporting and stakeholder engagement-Participate in weekly and monthly service review meetings, provide updates on performance and issues, and support stakeholder communication to ensure transparency and service alignment.

Team Management-Collaborate with team members to resolve open tickets and service requests.

Knowledge base and continuous learning Contribute to updating SOPs, knowledge articles and maintaining the knowledge repository for the purpose of future ticket resolution.

**͏**
-----

**͏**
-----

**͏**
-----

* **Primary Skill/ Mandatory Skill:** Strong experience in **M365 Admin Center** administration. Hands-on experience in **M365 license management** . Ability to manage the **application lifecycle** for Microsoft, Adobe, and other vendor applications

* **Secondary Skill / Good to have:** SCCM & Intune

* **locations :** Bangalore, Pune & Coimbatore

* **Shift Timings:** US Shift hours

Rate :-

Exp:-

  

Team Leadership:

* Lead, mentor, and manage a team of 10–12 application support professionals.

* Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, ensuring clear communication and timely resolution of issues.

* Provide technical guidance to the team, assisting in resolving complex, high-priority business application issues.

* Maintain detailed reporting and metrics to ensure SLA’s are met and to identify resource issues and process gaps.

Application Support & Troubleshooting:

* Manage end-to-end business application support processes, including incident, problem, and change management.

* Perform advanced troubleshooting of business applications, including O365, Adobe suites, and other enterprise software.

* Think critically and apply out-of-the-box solutions when standard methodologies do not resolve issues.

Ticket Management:

* Oversee incident and work request management through ServiceNow, ensuring SLAs and KPIs are consistently met.

* Effectively drive change management ensuring processes are followed.

* Drive SWAT calls, provide technical assistance during major incidents, and prepare Root Cause Analysis (RCA) reports.

* Maintain robust metrics to ensure KPI/SLA’s are met.

Process & Change Management:

* Implement and oversee change management processes, ensuring compliance with organizational policies.

* Maintain detailed process documentation covering all team procedures

* Collaborate with business/stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.

OS & Environment Support:

* Provide support for all OS environments, including Windows 11 Workstation, Mac OS, Windows and Unix servers across, all endpoints; physical, virtual, non-persistent and Citrix.

* Ensure compatibility and stability of applications across different operating systems and environments.

  

Required Skills & Qualifications:

* Strong knowledge and hands-on experience in application support and troubleshooting.

* Proficiency in SCCM, Intune, Vulnerability Management, Office 365, and Adobe suites.

* Experience with vendor/license management, including license harvesting and compliance.

* In-depth understanding of Office patch management managed via Intune/SCCM and related processes.

* Knowledge of Change Management frameworks (e.g., ITIL) and experience in driving changes effectively.

* Proven ability to manage incidents and service requests through tools like ServiceNow.

* Strong technical knowledge of OS environments

* Excellent communication skills in English (both verbal and written) with proper meeting and email etiquette.

* Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to think critically and adapt to different scenarios.

* M365 integrated app deployments in enterprise environments.

* Extensive hands-on experience in the SCCM and Intune Management consoles.

* Strong knowledge of modern deployment methodologies (on-prem, cloud, hybrid), MDM/MAM platforms, and endpoint management tools.

* Proficiency in packaging and deploying applications across Windows 11 workstations, macOS devices, Windows Server, and Unix environments.

* Expertise in merging and analyzing reports from AD, AAD, ServiceNow, CMDB, Flexera, Azure and similar systems to drive actionable insights.

* Familiarity with ITSM frameworks (ITIL preferred) and supporting technologies (e.g., Active Directory, GPOs).

* Proven leadership ability to manage multiple projects, set goals, train teams, and enforce operational rigor while ensuring security and consistency in application packaging standards.

* Exceptional communication and stakeholder management, with the ability to engage technical and non-technical audiences globally.

* Analytical mindset with a knack for problem-solving, troubleshooting, and driving process maturity through detailed documentation and QA enforcement.

* Adaptable, self-motivated, and passionate about technology, teamwork, and delivering top-tier customer service.

* Experience with BI reporting tools, including SQL querying, database management, and advanced Excel functions.

  
Mandatory Skills: Software Distribution and Patch Mgmt .  
Experience: 5-8 Years .  
Reinvent your world. We are building a modern Wipro. We are an end-to-end digital transformation partner with the boldest ambitions. To realize them, we need people inspired by reinvention. Of yourself, your career, and your skills. We want to see the constant evolution of our business and our industry. It has always been in our DNA - as the world around us changes, so do we. Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention.

title: Oracle Core DBA
description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.


**Your Role**
-------------


We are seeking experienced **Oracle Database Administrators (Oracle DBA)** to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing, maintaining, monitoring, optimizing, and securing Oracle database environments while ensuring high availability, performance, and reliability of mission\-critical applications.


* Install, configure, administer, and maintain Oracle Database environments.
* Manage database upgrades, migrations, patches, and refresh activities.
* Monitor database performance and proactively identify optimization opportunities.
* Perform database tuning, SQL tuning, and performance troubleshooting.
* Manage backup and recovery strategies using RMAN.
* Configure and support High Availability (HA) solutions including RAC, Data Guard, and ASM.
* Implement database security standards, user management, and access controls.
* Perform capacity planning, storage management, and database health checks.
**Your Profile**
----------------


* Troubleshoot and resolve production issues within defined SLAs.
* Support application deployment, release management, and database changes.
* Collaborate with infrastructure, application, and cloud teams to ensure seamless operations.
* Prepare and maintain operational documentation and SOPs.
* Hands\-on experience with: Oracle Database 12c, 19c, 21c or higher, Oracle RAC, Oracle Data Guard, Oracle ASM, RMAN Backup \& Recovery, Oracle Enterprise Manager (OEM), Database Performance Tuning, SQL \& PL/SQL
* Experience in database patching, upgrades, cloning, and migration activities.
* Strong knowledge of database security, auditing, and compliance standards.
* Experience managing large\-scale production environments.
* Good understanding of Linux/Unix operating systems.
**What you'll love about working with us**
------------------------------------------


* We value flexibility and support a healthy work\-life balance through remote and hybrid work options.
* Competitive compensation and benefits.
* Career development programs and certifications in cloud technologies.
* A diverse and inclusive workplace that fosters innovation and collaboration.
